**AHAWR Status Bot — control bot**

Long-polls Telegram every 30 s (getUpdates timeout 30 s, ~2880 executions/day) and handles both messages and callback_query. Only chats in `hermes_config.telegram_chat_id` are answered; others are counted silently. Mutating commands (control and edit) require a confirmation (inline button or one-time code, 2-min TTL) before any change is applied and are written to the audit table. The bot token lives in the `telegramApi` credential (REDACTED-BOT-TOKEN placeholder kept only here), never in the workflow file.
